Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TSLA.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.81 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 29% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 17% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 49 basis points to 46.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
